changelog.note: Rinnegan rework begins: Shinra Tensei (a clear blast sphere, cracked earth, dirt flung out), Bansho Ten'in (rings of force dragging the target in) and Chibaku Tensei (black core, violet rim, cracks and crater) - push and pull now share a 5 s wait. Naraka Path: the real King of Hell rises in violet flame, its face splits and its jaw drops to the floor, and an arm reaches out to heal you. Amaterasu rework: all-black fire everywhere, near-instant ignition, hold to keep burning what you look at, burns grow and spread by touch, bigger ground patches; Kagutsuchi spikes skewer and launch spears; the Kagutsuchi wall is a full ring you charge by holding the key; arrows streak as black fire. Dust Release is smoother, follows you, does constant damage and hits harder. Tsukuyomi: you now see the attacker's copies stabbing you (no more staring at the back of the cross). Infinite Tsukuyomi drains chakra. Raid crates now give everything they list. The Chunin Exam written test asks about the Naruto story.
Nindo Rifts 1.0.21 (permanent rifts into a blue-dusk copy of the world, walk-through portals) and Polytone, which the rifts need on your side.
Fixed getting kicked ("dim is null") when using /warp and other server teleports.

Wanted stars removed: no more automatic bounties, sightings or Bingo Book. Reputation stays: your kills and reputation show on the ninja card. Killing someone with a bad name raises it (more the worse their name); killing an innocent or someone with a good name lowers it.

Reputation: your kill count and reputation now show on the ninja card. Killing a wanted criminal or someone with a bad name raises it; killing an innocent or someone with a good name lowers it (Hero, Honorable, Neutral, Notorious, Villain). Spars, the tournament, raids, the PvP world and village wars don't count.

New: Dust Release (Fire + Earth + Wind kekkei tota, rarer DNA) with Primitive World Cone, Detachment of the Primitive World and Expanded Detachment. The ninja card now uses the scroll menu with red + buttons. Wanted levels (1-5 stars) for killing other players: bounties, sightings, the Bingo Book. Anyone can bind and carry a player under 30% health. Otsutsuki and the Ten-Tails host can fly. Eyes can't be stolen below level 25 or by someone 25+ levels apart. The Gedo Statue's wrists are fixed.

The Gedo Statue rises from the waist up, 1.5x bigger, hands held out palms up, with a seat on each of its ten fingertips (right-click to sit). Its own eyelids open one eye for each beast sealed. Sealing: the nine phantom dragons come out of its mouth and bite into the target, then the beast's chakra rises in a column into the mouth. New: bind a jinchuriki under 30% health (Akatsuki, Sneak + right-click) and carry them over your shoulder to the statue.
Fixed the seated Gedo Statue not showing up.

Fixed the crash when a Two-Headed Wolf gets thrown (by Palms Revolving Heaven and the like). DNA pity: every rejected vial makes the next likelier, guaranteed after 5 in a row. Raid pity: a legendary (kekkei genkai) DNA guaranteed every 50 waves without one.

The Gedo Statue now sits cross-legged with its palms up: ten finger seats for the Akatsuki, and sealing a tailed beast takes 3+ members on the fingers (40 min with 3, down to 10 with 7+). Staff can place a permanent one with /nindo gedo place.

Raids: no more getting stuck in the walls, loot comes in stackable crates, bandits don't drop kunai. Chunin Exam three times a week. Smaller charging aura, bond messages stop at max, bosses give real XP, the Ten-Tails can't linger in villages, and the rare Medical Scroll.

Conch mace rebuilt, Isobu's eye back, no second head in beast form, armor on your arms in first person, Otsutsuki robes for the Otsutsuki only, raids can't get stuck, DNA gives the missing release scroll, the element reroll asks which element, no bomb + jutsu multicast, baby zombie chakra networks, and a Speed Cap key ([).

21 character outfits (Naruto, Sasuke, the Sannin, Team Guy, the Sand Siblings, the Seven Swordsmen, Otsutsuki), the full samurai set, shinobi pants and sandals, a Farming shop tab, wave 50 raid armor, and the testers' balance and bug fixes.
